issue.title: Add aria-label to the booking page duration badge
issue.body: Harness test (simple change). In apps/web/modules/bookings/components/event-meta/Duration.tsx, give the duration text an accessible label like "Duration: 30 minutes" (localized, English key in packages/i18n/locales/en/common.json) without changing the visible text. Include a unit test.

pm.summary: Small accessibility fix to the booking page duration display: add a localized "Duration: X minutes" accessible label and leave the visible text as it is. Ready for implementation with a unit test.
acceptance_criteria: Problem: on the public booking page, `EventDuration` (apps/web/modules/bookings/components/event-meta/Duration.tsx) shows short text such as "30m" or "1h 30m". Screen readers read this as an unclear abbreviation. This affects screen-reader users who book events.
For a single-duration event (no multipleDuration, not dynamic), the rendered duration element has aria-label "Duration: 30 minutes" for a 30-minute event, and its visible text is still "30m".

When the event has multiple durations but `hideDurationSelectorInBookingPage` is true, the rendered duration text has an aria-label for the selected duration (or the default length if none is selected), e.g. "Duration: 60 minutes" or "Duration: 1 hour", and its visible text does not change.

When the multiple-duration selector is shown, each duration option has an aria-label in the same format (e.g. "Duration: 15 minutes"), and its visible label (e.g. "15m") does not change. The existing data-testid, data-active and click-to-select behavior still work.

The label spells out units with correct pluralization: 1 minute gives "Duration: 1 minute", 90 minutes gives a label that includes both "1 hour" and "30 minutes", and 120 minutes gives "Duration: 2 hours".

The label text comes from i18n: a new English key exists in packages/i18n/locales/en/common.json (e.g. "Duration: {{duration}}"), and the label is not a hardcoded English string. No other locale files are required.
The visible layout is unchanged: the same text, classes and positions as before, with no extra visible characters.
`getDurationFormatted` keeps its current output, so BookFormAsModal, which also uses it, shows exactly what it shows today.

A new unit test inside apps/web/ (e.g. next to Duration.tsx or in apps/web/modules/bookings/components/) renders EventDuration. It checks the aria-label for at least the single-duration case and one hours case, and checks that the visible short text is unchanged. The test passes with the repo's existing test runner.
Out of scope: the visible duration format, other event-meta blocks (location, price, etc.), the BookFormAsModal duration, non-English translations, and any dependency or tooling changes.
